description.value: A municipal campground on the banks of the Bulkley River in Smithers, offering an in-town base with straightforward bike access and proximity to local services; specific amenities are unconfirmed from available sources.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully and confirms the campground is an active Town of Smithers facility, with 'Riverside Municipal Campground' appearing in the site navigation under Parks, Recreation & Culture. However, the fetched content is almost entirely navigation/menu boilerplate — no campground-specific amenity details were captured, so most optional amenities must be null. OSM tags confirm tents=yes, caravans=yes, sanitary_dump_station=yes, wheelchair=yes, and fee=yes, which are used as supplementary evidence.
concerns: Website fetch returned almost entirely navigation/menu boilerplate with no campground-specific content (amenities, facilities, booking info). A manual review of https://www.smithers.ca/campground is recommended to fill in amenity gaps.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active municipal campground in Smithers that accepts tents and is operated by the Town — a clear fit for touring cyclists along the Bulkley Valley corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags note sanitary_dump_station=yes and wheelchair=yes, but these could not be corroborated via website content due to the fetch returning only site navigation.
